_doc: PROVISIONAL SYNTHETIC normative model in HFA-equivalent dB. NOT derived from measured data on this device. A synthetic normal population is generated from this model (seeded) and the normative database is then built from it exactly as it will be built from a real cohort (pointwise age regression + empirical percentiles, as in visualFields::nvgenerate). Synthetic subjects = model + global shift + between-subject local variation (localSd) + test-retest measurement noise (measurementSd), so percentiles reflect MEASURED normal fields as in a real normative database.
